summary: Iteration 2: Notification Preferences feature fully verified. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (auth guard, GET defaults, PUT persistence, invalid-day filtering, empty-list fallback, blank-email→null, reminder respects in_app_enabled/email_enabled/reminder_days/notification_email). Frontend: /settings loads, all data-testids present, email-toggle conditionally hides notification-email-input, day-chip toggle works, save-preferences-btn triggers PUT /api/preferences 200 with correct payload, success toast 'Tercihler kaydedildi' displayed, nav-settings visible in sidebar and navigates properly.
passed: GET /api/preferences returns defaults {email_enabled:true, in_app_enabled:true, reminder_days:[3,1], notification_email:null}
PUT /api/preferences saves & GET returns persisted values
PUT filters invalid reminder_days (0, -1, 100 dropped; 3,5 kept)
PUT with empty reminder_days falls back to [3,1]
PUT with whitespace-only notification_email stored as null
check-reminders with in_app_enabled=false & email_enabled=false creates 0 notifications (early return)
check-reminders with in_app_enabled=true creates in-app notification with email_sent=false when email disabled
check-reminders uses custom reminder_days (7 triggers, 3 skipped when prefs=[7])
check-reminders stores prefs.notification_email override correctly in user_preferences
/settings route renders settings-page and all channel/email/day/save testids present
Toggling email-toggle OFF hides notification-email-input, ON reveals it
save-preferences-btn triggers PUT returning updated prefs (200) and shows success toast
nav-settings appears in sidebar with correct label 'Ayarlar' and navigates to /settings
test_credentials: Test user created via mongosh (see /app/auth_testing.md). Session token: test_session_prefs_1783951471825 (for /app/memory/test_credentials.md reference).
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral test user + session + pending checks via API inside test fixtures (auto-cleaned in teardown). One long-lived UI session user retained for browser testing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 826 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting notifications/preferences into a separate router module for maintainability.

Email delivery (Resend) not verified end-to-end since RESEND_API_KEY may be absent; _send_email gracefully returns False. If prod email delivery matters, add an integration test with a valid key or mock.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preferences feature is stable. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_preferences.py reusable as regression. iteration_1 tests still valid. If adding new prefs fields, extend _get_prefs DEFAULT_PREFS merge logic — currently strict to whitelist keys.
